correctness.rationale: At \(q=1/4\), the repeated-root recurrence gives \(G_j=j2^{1-j}\) and hence the stated positive weights. For even \(j\), Euler's zeta formula factors every magnitude into a common \(N\)-dependent term times \(\omega_j\zeta(N-j)\), with the displayed adjacent ratio \(R_j\). The inequalities \(R_2>1\), \(R_4\zeta(4)<1\), and the uniform \(j\ge6\) tail bound force strict decrease from \(j=4\) onward for every even \(N\ge10\), while the \(j=4\) to \(j=2\) comparison is strictly greater than one. The exact \(N=4,6,8\) ratios give modes \(2,4,6\). A fresh independent direct evaluation of the original zeta summands through even \(N=60\) reproduced \(2,4,6,4,4,\ldots\); the universal conclusion rests on the ratio inequalities, not the finite replay.
